name: info-card
title: Info Card
description: A reusable section for displaying labeled detail items in flexible layouts (inline, grid, stack, wrap).

docs.lead: Display labeled key-value detail items within a section card. Supports inline, grid, stacked, and wrapped layouts. Each item has a label and a custom-rendered value as children. The value container defaults to text-label-xs and text-sub-600 styling.
docs.usage:
import * as InfoCard from "@/components/ui/info-card"

<InfoCard.Root layout="inline">
  <InfoCard.Item>
    <InfoCard.Label>Label</InfoCard.Label>
    <InfoCard.Value>Value content</InfoCard.Value>
  </InfoCard.Item>
</InfoCard.Root>

examples.title: Inline
examples.description: Items displayed side by side, each taking equal width. Uses Avatar for the user image.
examples.code: import { RiTimeLine } from '@remixicon/react' import * as Avatar from '@/components/ui/avatar' import * as InfoCard from '@/components/ui/info-card' Submitted date Jan 3, 2025 Created by Sean Muir

examples.title: Inline with Full Width Item
examples.description: Mix inline and full-width items using the fullWidth prop. Uses StatusBadge for the status value and Avatar for the user image.
examples.code: import { RiAlertFill, RiTimeLine } from '@remixicon/react' import * as Avatar from '@/components/ui/avatar' import * as InfoCard from '@/components/ui/info-card' import * as StatusBadge from '@/components/ui/status-badge' Submitted date Jan 3, 2025 Created by Sean Muir Publication status Require changes

examples.title: Grid (2 Columns)
examples.description: Items arranged in a fixed 2-column grid. Uses Badge for category and priority values.
examples.code: import { RiCalendarLine } from '@remixicon/react' import * as Badge from '@/components/ui/badge' import * as InfoCard from '@/components/ui/info-card' Start date Mar 1, 2025 End date Jun 30, 2025 Category Technology Priority High

examples.title: Stacked
examples.description: Items stacked vertically, each taking full width. Uses Avatar and StatusBadge.

examples.title: With Action
examples.description: Inline layout with a default action button. The action renders as a square button with an arrow icon.
examples.code: import { RiTimeLine } from '@remixicon/react' import * as Avatar from '@/components/ui/avatar' import * as InfoCard from '@/components/ui/info-card' Submitted date Jan 3, 2025 Created by Sean Muir

examples.title: With Custom Action
examples.description: Action button with a custom icon. Pass children to override the default arrow icon.
examples.code: import { RiExternalLinkLine } from '@remixicon/react' import * as InfoCard from '@/components/ui/info-card' import * as StatusBadge from '@/components/ui/status-badge' Application ID #APP-2025-0142 Status Approved

examples.title: Grid (3 Columns)
examples.description: Items arranged in a fixed 3-column grid. Uses Badge for the duration value.
examples.code: import { RiCalendarLine } from '@remixicon/react' import * as Badge from '@/components/ui/badge' import * as InfoCard from '@/components/ui/info-card' Amount $25,000 Duration 12 months Deadline Dec 31, 2025

api.name: InfoCard.Root
api.description: The container for info card items. Controls layout and spacing.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of columns when layout is 'grid'.

api.name: InfoCard.Item
api.description: An individual card containing a label and value.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: When true, the item spans the full width of the container.

api.name: InfoCard.Label
api.description: The label text for an info card item.

api.name: InfoCard.Value
api.description: The value container for custom-rendered content. Defaults to text-label-xs and text-text-sub-600 styling.

api.name: InfoCard.Action
api.description: A square action button styled like an info card item. Stretches to match sibling item height and maintains a square aspect ratio. Renders a default RiArrowRightUpLine icon that can be overridden via children. Full-width on small containers, square on larger ones.
